title: Grab And Move should work with TouchScreen & Stylus

actions.label: Clarify touch and stylus support scope
actions.note: Draft a maintainer scope note for touch/stylus support.

comment.body: I re-checked the current Grab and Move implementation, and it is explicitly built around **modifier + mouse drag** input. The module description and the current source both target mouse-button interactions; there is no touchscreen or stylus pointer path in the existing implementation. I would answer this as feature-scope feedback rather than a regression bug, because supporting touch/stylus drag would require new pointer-input handling instead of fixing a broken already-supported path.

issue_context.summary: Grab and Move currently supports modifier + mouse-button drags; touch and stylus interactions are not part of the implemented input path.
known_information: The reporter wants Grab and Move to react to Win/Alt plus touchscreen or stylus drag on a 2-in-1 device.
The current module description only promises Alt+Drag with left/right mouse buttons.
The module installs low-level keyboard and mouse hooks and contains no pointer-type or stylus logic.
inferences: The issue is asking for broader input-device support than the current feature scope, not describing a break in an already-supported touch path.
issue_context.analysis: This should not become bug-fix design work in the dashboard batch. The implementation surface would be new pointer-input handling and likely product UX decisions.
initial_investigation: Confirmed the module currently hooks mouse and keyboard input only.
Did not find touchscreen/stylus-specific code in the Grab and Move module tree.

judgment.rationale: The current Grab and Move implementation is explicitly mouse-driven; touch and stylus input would require new pointer-input support rather than fixing a regression in the existing Alt+Drag/Win+Drag mouse path.
evidence: GrabAndMoveModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp describes the feature as `Move and resize windows with Alt+Drag (left button to move, right button to resize)`.
GrabAndMove/main.cpp installs low-level keyboard and mouse hooks, not WM_POINTER or stylus-specific processing.
A repository search did not find touchscreen, stylus, or pointer-type handling in the Grab and Move module.
judgment.recommended_action: Respond that the current module only supports mouse-based drag interactions and that touchscreen/stylus support would be feature work, not a scoped bug fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The requested behavior is outside the currently implemented input surface and would require new feature work.
